seriesTitle: The Emperor: Owner of the Mask

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: In order to ensure that her son will be a good and wise King, his mother tries to delay his birth. Someone has poisoned the young Prince.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: In order to ensure that her son will be a good and wise King, his mother tries to delay his birth. Someone has poisoned the young Prince.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince finds he cannot stand by and watch a villager lose his hand for stealing some water to save his family, but there are unexpected consequences.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince finds he cannot stand by and watch a villager lose his hand for stealing some water to save his family, but there are unexpected consequences.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Hwa Goon vows to win the Crown Prince's heart. The Crown Prince finds out why he must wear the mask.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince tries to save Ga Eun's father, but that proves to be more difficult than he expected.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince asks Woo Bo how to eradicate the Pyeonsoo-hwe. King Yeongjo looks for another Lee Seon.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Eun Ha finds proof that her father was innocent. The Crown Prince teaches Lee Seon how to impersonate him.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Hwa Goon helps the Crown Prince and Dae Mok tells Lee Seon that he must now wear the mask.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: After five years, Chilpye is a thriving marketplace and the Queen Regent has not yet stepped down.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince rescues Ga Eun but keeps his identity a secret. The palace is surprised when Lee Seon makes a ruling that does not side with the Pyeonsoo-hwe.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince persuades the largest merchants to rise up against Dae Mok, and then goes off in search of copper.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Ga Eun is desperate to find the pot that will clear her father's name. Lee Seon is heartbroken to have to pretend he does not know Ga Eun.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince goes to the meet point to catch the copper thieves in the act.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince uses the stolen copper to further his plan. Lee Seon finds a way to invite Ga Eun back to the palace.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Dowager Queen has her own plans for Ga Eun. The Crown Prince overhears Ga Eun pining for Chun Soo.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.summary: Hwa Goon makes a deal with her grandfather to save the Crown Prince. People are starting to figure out who the Crown Prince really is.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.summary: Yang tries to draw the location of the poison. Lee Seon sneaks out of the palace to see his family and runs into some people he did not expect to see.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince is worried that Ga Eun has made a terrible decision. Ga Eun figures out who really drew the map.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.summary: Dowager Queen enlists Ga Eun to help her figure out what hold the Pyeonsoo-hwe have over the King. Word that the King is a fake has begun to spread.

episodes.title: Episode 21
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince has to decide if moving the army from the border to attack the Pyeonsoo-hwe is the right move.

episodes.title: Episode 22
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince asks Hwa Goon to help him stop Choi Heon's army. The palace prepares for the Dowager Queen's birthday celebration.

episodes.title: Episode 23
episodes.summary: Lee Seon tells Ga Eun that he did not kill her father. The Dowager Queen plans to use the Crown Prince to fight the Pyeonsoo-hwe.

episodes.title: Episode 24
episodes.summary: When the Crown Prince sneaks into Dae Mok's house, he learns more than he bargained for. The Dowager Queen starts the Queen selection process.

episodes.title: Episode 25
episodes.summary: Lee Seon and the Crown Prince worry about Ga Eun. Hwa Goon joins the marriage selection process as a judge.

episodes.title: Episode 26
episodes.summary: Falsely imprisoned, Ga Eun is visited by both the Crown Prince and Lee Seon.

episodes.title: Episode 27
episodes.summary: Lee Seon is unsure what to make of the Crown Prince's gift and he makes some surprising moves.

episodes.title: Episode 28
episodes.summary: Ga Eun is heartbroken to learn the truth.

episodes.title: Episode 29
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince is determined to save Ga Eun, but Dae Mok is one step ahead of him.

episodes.title: Episode 30
episodes.summary: Following the Crown Prince's initiation into the Pyeonsoo-hwe, there is a power shift in the palace.

episodes.title: Episode 31
episodes.summary: Ga Eun and Lee Seon's family worry about his safety as he pursues what he wants.

episodes.title: Episode 32
episodes.summary: Hwa Goon takes her revenge on Dae Mok.

episodes.title: Episode 33
episodes.summary: Hwa Goon faces Dae Mok's wrath

episodes.title: Episode 34
episodes.summary: The Crown Prince wonders if he has the right to reclaim the throne.

episodes.title: Episode 35
episodes.summary: Lee Seon refuses to give up Ga Eun. The Crown Prince secures some alliances.

episodes.title: Episode 36
episodes.summary: Ga Eun continues her search for the mysterious jar. The Crown Prince puts his plan in action.

episodes.title: Episode 37
episodes.summary: Who is the real King? The Dowager Queen must decide which side she is on.

episodes.title: Episode 38
episodes.summary: The real King dismisses the members of the Pyeonsoo-hwe. Figuring out the antidote to the deadly flower pills is the new priority.

episodes.title: Episode 39
episodes.summary: Dae Mok tries to incite a riot in the palace. The King is surprised when Woo Jae offers assistance.

episodes.title: Episode 40
episodes.summary: In the series finale, Ga Eun makes a decision that she thinks is for the best. Lee Seon makes a terrible realization.
